title: TIBlender: Early-Warning Threat Intelligence from Cross-Platform Social Media Evidence
description:
Implementation and released dataset of the ACSAC 2026 paper "TIBlender: Early-Warning Threat Intelligence from Cross-Platform Social Media Evidence".

The code (everything outside dataset/) is released under the TIBlender Research and Evaluation License (see LICENSE). The dataset in dataset/ is released under CC BY-NC 4.0 (see dataset/LICENSE). Both allow non-commercial research use; no patent rights are granted.

Project page: https://tiblender.github.io/
